title: On the performance of pure and group 2B transition metal-doped metal oxide nanocages as single-atom catalysts for the hydrogen storage process: a DFT study
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,44495-44507
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06216K, Paper

Mohammed N. I. Shehata, Lamiaa A. Mohamed, Hu Yang, Tamer Shoeib, Jabir H. Al-Fahemi, Mahmoud A. A. Ibrahim
The efficiency of pure and group 2B transition metal-doped metal oxide nanocages as single-atom catalysts (M12O12 and TM-M11O12, M = Zn, Mg, and Be; TM = Zn, Cd, and Hg) for the hydrogen dissociation reaction was investigated using DFT calculations.
